nodes.label: Overlay Racing Logo (football/assets/logo.png)
nodes.description: Brand logo on black background: silver/red 'OR' monogram with checkered-flag speed lines, a mock timing-tower panel, 'OVERLAY RACING' wordmark and tagline 'Software para graficas de automovilismo'. Same racing brand asset reused inside the football module.
nodes.rationale: Football module mirrors the race module's branding and UI (same palette: black, silver, red), so the racing logo is reused rather than a football-specific mark.
